== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Yushi is a [[Herald]] who follows the lightning [[Path]] and is recognized as one of [[Reigan Shen]]'s closest associates. Though she is frequently referred to by the moniker [[Thunder Fairy]], a title she dislikes, her movements are noted for being mesmerizing. Physically, she possesses long brown hair and a delicate appearance that belies her true power; she also features wings that crackle with electricity and a spark located on the center of her forehead. In combat, she utilizes lightning-based techniques and carries a [[sword]]. During conflict, she has demonstrated the ability to send coded messages to others, such as the [[Storm Sage]], and has been known to target opponents with lethal precision. Following her death, a [[Remnant]] formed that appeared as an inhuman, diamond-like humanoid shape with lacy wings and lightning effects. As part of a diplomatic arrangement involving Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius, she was designated to serve a [[Sage]] for a period of one year.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As the [[Thunder Fairy]] and right hand to [[Reigan Shen]], Yushi is a [[Herald]] distinguished by a spark at the center of her forehead and wings that crackle with lightning. During her interactions with [[Yerin]], she is noted for possessing a pleasant and melodious laugh. While participating in battle, the immense pressure of the conflict made her feel as though she were facing a [[Monarch]]. Ultimately, Yushi possesses a diamond-like [[Remnant]].}}
